hero.title: Papua Paradise Center Association
hero.subtitle: Indigenous lands protected, indigenous communities thriving.

about.visionText: To empower Papuan people to thrive with strong character, humanity, social entrepreneurship, and deep reverence for nature and culture, rooted in the spirit of Noken philosophy.
missionList: Collaborate with communities and groups that share our vision and values.
Build character, skills, and environmental awareness in Papua's youngest generation.
Advocate for and support indigenous communities in preserving their locally-rooted principles and ways of life amid globalization.
Advance grassroots economic empowerment for tribal communities and women's groups.
Cultivate profound respect for nature and revitalize endangered cultural traditions.
Champion and support GEDSI (Gender Equality, Disability, and Social Inclusion) principles.

programs.title: Our Programs
programs.subtitle: Initiatives born from a commitment to empower communities and sustain our environment.

items.title: Contextual Education
items.description: Children learn through play at Paradise Nature School, developing character, language, and talents. Every experience is contextual, joyful, and rooted in everyday life.

items.title: Grassroots Economy
items.description: We help local communities build enterprises around cultural products like noken, virgin coconut oil, and traditional snacks, growing economically while honoring their heritage.

items.title: Indigenous Forests and Environment
items.description: We work with indigenous communities to map forests, protect ecosystems, transform plastic into EcoBricks, plant mangroves, and organize clean-ups.
